L21: # Why do ACE recommendations have start and end dates?
L22: 
L23: 【11†Image†secure.gravatar.com】
L24: 
L25: 【12†Jesus Ventura】
L26: 
L27:   * February 03, 2026 21:05
L28:   * Updated
L29: 
L30: ACE credit recommendations have start and end dates to ensure academic integrity and to help colleges and universities verify that the training you completed matches the credit awarded.
L31: Training programs, professional certifications, and military occupations change over time. Content is updated, learning outcomes are revised, and industry standards evolve. ACE faculty evaluators review these experiences periodically—typically every three to five years—to ensure they continue to meet college-level standards.
L32: The dates ensure that the credit recommendation matches the exact version of the training you completed. If you complete a course after the end date, you're likely completing a newer version that has undergone a separate faculty evaluation with potentially different credit recommendations.
L33: 
L34: We recommend checking the 【1†ACE National Guide†www.acenet.edu】 or 【13†ACE Military Guide†militaryguide.acenet.edu】 for the most current credit recommendations.
L35: What if my completion date is outside of the range? ACE credit recommendations will not appear on your transcript. Your training completion date must match the date range on the listing. Many courses and occupations have multiple "exhibits" reflecting different time periods.

L21: # What if I completed a learning experience outside of the start and end dates listed?
L22: 
L23: 【11†Image†secure.gravatar.com】
L24: 
L25: 【12†Jesus Ventura】
L26: 
L27:   * February 25, 2026 21:35
L28:   * Updated
L29: 
L30: If your learning experience was completed after the end date of a recommendation period or if you completed your training before the start date of a recommendation period, you are not eligible to receive a badge or ACE Transcript.
L31: It is important to communicate with your training provider about your intent to utilize ACE credit recommendations and to verify that you understand their plans to continue the ACE renewal process so you can ensure that there are no issues with your transcript.
L32: ##### Why Your Completion Date May be Outside Dates: Common Scenarios
L33: 
L34:   * You finished the course before the organization requested ACE evaluation
L35:   * Your completion date predates the effective start date
L36:   * The organization did not renew their ACE recommendations
L37:   * You completed the training after the end date passed
L38:   * Your organization renewed, but, there is a gap between the old and new effective dates because the training was significantly revised
